summary: Armstrong World Industries filed an 8-K announcing its Board approved an additional $800 million share repurchase authorization, raising the total to $2.5 billion, and extending the program through December 31, 2029. The company also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.339 per share, payable August 19, 2026, to holders of record on August 5, 2026. Repurchases may occur via open market, block trades, or negotiated deals, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, with no commitment to buy any specific amount. The program can be suspended anytime. This is a pure capital allocation event; no M&A or activist catalyst is disclosed. Watch for ongoing buyback execution pace and any future changes to dividend policy.
